verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents an interactive API reference with runnable examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, and the shutdown notice says the docs tree is removed and there is no longer a documented API surface to explore. The server-page "try" feature lets users try MCP servers, which is a different capability from exploring an API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
